name: SP3 Precise Orbit Source
description: Read precise orbit products in SP3-c and SP3-d (IGS and its analysis centres, BKG, ESA/ESOC: GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, BeiDou and low-Earth-orbit POD) into one canonical SDS OEM per satellite, in the frame and time system the header states, position-only states staying position-only (typed contracts 1.0: FlatBuffers only, no JSON between modules). read_sp3 takes the hostcap/http-request HttpResponse, BODY the decompressed SP3 text verbatim, and writes the $OEM frames plus one FlowNotice report (Info: COUNT the $OEM emitted, ITEMS the header facts, the per-satellite counts and the SHA-256 of the file as name=value). HTTP 304 gives one FlowNotice (Unchanged) and no $OEM; another status or a transport error is refused. Download, decompression and storage belong to the SDN host flow; no hostcalls.

methods.displayName: Read an SP3 precise orbit file as OEM

acceptedTypeSets.description: The HttpResponse (HRSP) from hostcap/http-request for one SP3-c or SP3-d precise orbit file (IGS, its analysis centres, BKG, ESA/ESOC): BODY the decompressed text verbatim, bounded to 128 MiB (the host expands the gzip the data centres serve); STATUS 200, or 304 for unchanged.

inputPorts.description: The HttpResponse (HRSP) from hostcap/http-request for one SP3-c or SP3-d precise orbit file (IGS, its analysis centres, BKG, ESA/ESOC): BODY the decompressed text verbatim, bounded to 128 MiB (the host expands the gzip the data centres serve); STATUS 200, or 304 for unchanged.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One canonical $OEM per satellite with a position in the file, named for its SP3 vehicle id: Earth-fixed in the realization the header names (or the inertial frame it names), on the file's time system, position-only or with velocity as the file has it.

outputPorts.description: One canonical $OEM per satellite with a position in the file, named for its SP3 vehicle id: Earth-fixed in the realization the header names (or the inertial frame it names), on the file's time system, position-only or with velocity as the file has it.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One FlowNotice (FNTC): KIND Info, SCHEMA OEM, SOURCE_NAME sp3, COUNT the $OEM emitted, ITEMS the header facts (fileVersion, positionVelocity, agency, coordinateSystem, orbitType, dataUsed, timeSystem, frame, gpsWeek, epochIntervalSeconds, firstEpoch, declaredEpochs, satelliteCount, satellitesWithoutStates, sha256, bytes) and per satellite satellite.<id>.states/blocks/velocity/accuracyExponent/clock/predictedStates/maneuverFlags, as name=value; or KIND Unchanged (REASON not-modified, ITEMS the URL) for a 304.

outputPorts.description: One FlowNotice (FNTC): KIND Info, SCHEMA OEM, SOURCE_NAME sp3, COUNT the $OEM emitted, ITEMS the header facts (fileVersion, positionVelocity, agency, coordinateSystem, orbitType, dataUsed, timeSystem, frame, gpsWeek, epochIntervalSeconds, firstEpoch, declaredEpochs, satelliteCount, satellitesWithoutStates, sha256, bytes) and per satellite satellite.<id>.states/blocks/velocity/accuracyExponent/clock/predictedStates/maneuverFlags, as name=value; or KIND Unchanged (REASON not-modified, ITEMS the URL) for a 304.

sequentialJustification.detail: One complete bounded orbit file is read in order into one record per satellite and one FlowNotice; the host parallelizes independent files and this parser creates no threads.
